description: This file contains unit tests for the AndroidUserDictionary class, including setup of a mock content provider, testing word validation, observer registration, and handling of missing content provider scenarios.

classes.name: AndroidUserDictionaryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AndroidUserDictionary, testing dictionary loading, word validation, observer registration, and exception handling.

classes.name: AUDContentProvider
classes.description: Mock content provider class used for testing AndroidUserDictionary, simulating the user dictionary database.

classes.name: Words
classes.description: Inner static class defining the schema for the words table in the mock content provider.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the mock content provider and populates it with dummy words before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the mock content provider and cleans up after each test.

methods.name: testLoadedWordsEN
methods.description: Tests loading the dictionary with English locale and verifies word validity.

methods.name: testLoadedWordsNULL
methods.description: Tests loading the dictionary with null locale and verifies word validity.

methods.name: testLoadedWordsWhenNoContentProvider
methods.description: Ensures that loading the dictionary when no content provider exists throws a RuntimeException.

methods.name: testRegisterObserver
methods.description: Verifies that content observers are registered and notified upon data changes.
